# Introduction

Wraiths are aggressive creatures found in Swamps. They are dark blueish spectral entities, cloaked with a hood covering their blank face. They emit a quiet snarling hiss sound when they are aggravated. Since they naturally spawn at night, glow and fly, spotting them from a distance is easy; their telltale glow reveals them even to inattentive players as they approach.

## Drops

• Item: Chain | 0 Star: 1

• Item: Wraith trophy | 0 Star: 5%

## Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Swamps during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Uncommon | Stars: No

• Type: Rare spawn point near Abandoned Huts in Swamps, also during the daytime | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: During "You feel a chill down your spine..." event after defeating Bonemass | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

### Melee

Swipes at the player with their claw, creating a 60-degree vertical arc that extends 2.4 meters outward (60 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds within 1.8 meters of the player.

## Notes

• Wraiths can be especially dangerous when entering Swamps early on, with Black Forest-tier gear. It is best to avoid entering the biome at night for this reason.
• Wraiths are the only renewable source of Chains, the other major source being Sunken Crypts.
• Because of their Spirit damage weakness (and considering their Physical damage resistance), Silver weapons are around 90% effective, making them a good choice. However, due to Wraith's immunity to Frost damage, the Frostner is only about 50% effective, making it a bad choice.
• Wraiths can fly directly on top of you if you get under them correctly, making them unable to hit you, while being vulnerable to two-handed Clubs like the Stagbreaker.
